messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate observed from rw-eu inference cluster (prefix-cache write amplification). Auto-pager triggered. See metrics: https://grafana.redwood/inference/eu/prefix-cache
alex_chen: I'm seeing a spike in KV write ops and continuous-batching latencies. Error type: `kv::prefix_conflict` + `batcher_timeout` in the runtime logs.
maria_ops: @alex_chen +1. CPU on serving nodes at 95% and tail P99 token latency jumped to ~1.2s. A subset of requests are generating massively long prefixes (template drift?) and creating huge prefix keys.
ryan_sre: Paging in. I'm on it. First quick question: any recent rollout to tokenizer/prompt templating in EU? deploy-bot: deploy:service/infra/tokenizer v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 promoted to eu at 2025-11-03T02:45Z by @ci-cd
alex_chen: That lines up. We're seeing mismatch between serialization of prompt templates and the prefix hashing logic. Token counts for same user prompt doubled.
sophia_prodeng: CSMs reporting latency affects embeddings and chat heavy customers in EU region (low RPS but high cost). @tara_csm can you surface impacted customers?
tara_csm: Quick note — two customers (Mapline and NoteFlow) just filed support tickets about timeouts; Mapline saw 15% request failure rate in last 10m. Sharing note to their CSMs.
ryan_sre: Immediate mitigations I'm planning:
- blocklist tokenization version v2.4.0 on the router for EU (route to fallback tokenizer v2.3.1)
- apply a throttling policy on prefix writes (`prefix_write_limit=100/s`) via runtime flags
- evict oversized prefix keys older than 30m from KV cache (safe-mode)
Can someone approve the runtime flags change? This will transiently increase 429s for writes.
alex_chen: Approve for emergency mitigation. We need to avoid cache blowup. Also we should increase `batcher_max_batch_size` down to 8 for EU as a hotfix.
maria_ops: I'll run the evict job and ensure TTL override script uses safe filters. Command I'll run:
```
./tools/kvctl evict --env=eu --prefix="user:prefix:" --older-than=1800 --dry-run=false
```
ryan_sre: Doing router blocklist now: `routerctl set-tokenizer-blacklist --region=eu --version=2.4.0`
deploy-bot: action: routerctl set-tokenizer-blacklist --region=eu --version=2.4.0 completed by deploy-bot
maria_ops: Evict job started. Estimated completion 3m.
alex_chen: Patch for batcher config applied to canary pool (eu-canary). Snippet:
```yaml
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 8
  max_wait_ms: 12
  kv_write_rate_limit: 100
```
ryan_sre: Canary results: tail latency reduced by ~350ms and KV write rate down 60% after blocklist + small batches. No regressions in correctness checks so far.
tara_csm: Notifying Mapline & NoteFlow that we're mitigating and will follow up with postmortem. They appreciate the quick updates.
sophia_prodeng: Any sign of data corruption or persisted invalid prefix keys? We need to know if we must run a rehash job later.
alex_chen: No corruption seen; keys are present but many are oversized due to template tokenization differences. We'll plan a safe rehash & compaction later.
ryan_sre: Next steps:
- keep throttles & batcher caps for 1h and monitor
- schedule background compaction/rehash sweep with a safe window (low traffic)
- run regression test against template v2.4.0 serialization to reproduce
- postmortem owner: @alex_chen
maria_ops: Evict job finished. KV write ops back to nominal in ~80s. Monitoring is green but tail latency still ~120ms above baseline.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT update — mitigations applied at 1939991260. Current status: degraded -> stabilizing. No customer-facing outage escalation required at this time.
tara_csm: Customer impact summary for external notes:
- Scope: EU inference cluster only
- Symptoms: elevated 5xx and timeouts for prefix-dependent workloads (chat & embeddings)
- Impacted: Mapline (15% failure window), NoteFlow (intermittent timeouts), internal experiments; no data loss
- Mitigation: rolled back tokenizer v2.4.0 routing, evicted oversized prefix keys, reduced batch sizes and set prefix write limits
- ETA for full resolution: 6-12 hours for compaction and rehash job and verification
ryan_sre: Handoff — @maria_ops you can take next watch. I'll remain reachable for 30m for escalations then hand to night on-call.
maria_ops: Taking watch, staying on until 1939991320. Will escalate to @ryan_sre if anything > 5xx spike.
alex_chen: I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups: reproduce locally, patch tokenizer serialization, add canary for tokenizer upgrades, add metrics for prefix key size distribution.
incidents-bot: Incident closed to active paging at 1939991320. Follow-up actions: postmortem in #postmortems, rewrite canary policy, add alert for prefix_key_size_p95 > 500 bytes.
sophia_prodeng: Thx team. Please include customer-facing timeline and a short remediation plan in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
